newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI reorganises to focus on core business.
newsitem.headline: JCI reorganises to focus on core business.

text.p: JCI Ltd on Wednesday announced plans for the reorganisation of its internal structure in order to focus on its core business and ensure its growth strategy was implemented effectively.
It said nine business areas would be affected by the reorganisation.
These were information services, internal audit, head office security, organisational development, vehicles services, investments, pensions administration, catering and cleaning.
In each case, the group was considering options such as buying services from outside suppliers and rationalising the organisation of service delivery.

EDS and Deloitte & Touche had been selected as the preferred service providers for information and internal audit respectively and all staff in these departments would be offered positions in the relevant company.

In the other seven areas, discussions were continuing with both staff and external providers, while every attempt was being made to ensure the proposals made good sense not only in business but also people terms.
Managing director Bill Nairn said the company's aim was to build JCI Ltd into a mining company of international subtance and distinction.

"To achieve this we must run our existing operations at maximum efficiency and profitability, as well as be able to access world-class mineral deposits and the investment capital and technologies to exploit them," he said.
"We must have an organisation that is totally focused on its core business, buying in non-core services from specialist outside suppliers," Nairn added.
